name: UpdateSubscription

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Cloud Contact Center instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: For Message Queue (MQ), enter the Group ID. For webhook, enter PID\_Webhook
parameters.help_zh:
MQ方式，对应GroupId。
Webhook方式，填写PID_Webhook
parameters.name: producer_id

parameters.help_en: For MQ, enter the topic name. For webhook, enter Topic\_Webhook
parameters.name: default_topic

parameters.help_en: The endpoint for MQ. The service endpoint for webhook
parameters.help_zh: MQ的接入地址。Webhook的服务地址
parameters.name: access_point

parameters.help_en:
The message push type.

- rocketmq4

- rocketmq5

- webhook
parameters.help_zh:
消息推送类型。
- rocketmq4
- rocketmq5
- webhook
parameters.name: mq_type

parameters.help_en: The MQ username. Specify this only when MqType is rocketmq5
parameters.help_zh: MQ用户名，只有当MqType==rocketmq5时，需要指定
parameters.name: username

parameters.help_en: The MQ password. Specify this only when MqType is rocketmq5
parameters.help_zh: MQ 密码，只有当 MqType==rocketmq5 时，需要指定
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The MQ instance ID. Specify this only when MqType is rocketmq4 or rocketmq5
